## What's new

### The whole Quran is in the installer
- **Reads with no internet from the first launch.** The Arabic text of all 114 surahs (with Tajweed markup and IndoPak spelling) and all 604 Mushaf page fonts now ship with the app. Only audio, other translations and reciter portraits need a connection.
- The installer is larger because of this (about 100 MB), and so are updates.

### Reading
- **Smoother Reading scroll mode.** Only the pages near the window are drawn, so long surahs scroll without lag and the playing verse is followed without stutter.

### Fixes
- **Tajweed:** the word highlight now matches the Tajweed letters and keeps the rule colours as the recitation sweeps through each word. Added the missing colours for Ikhfa and the obligatory Madd rules.
